name: google_drive
description: Access Google Drive files and external URLs. Actions: list (all files), recent (recently modified), search (find by name/content), info (metadata for one file), read (read full text content of a file — works for Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, PDFs, text files), read_by_name (search and read in one step by file name), list_folders (list all Drive folders), list_folder (list contents of a folder by folder_id or name), read_url (fetch and read ANY external URL or Google Drive share link — extracts readable text from HTML pages, Google Docs export links, raw text files). Use read/read_by_name/read_url whenever the user wants to see what's INSIDE a file, not just its name.

action.description: list: all files. recent: recently modified. search: find by query. info: metadata only. read: read full TEXT CONTENT of a file by file_id (Google Docs/Sheets/text/PDF). read_by_name: search then read in one step — pass a name. read_url: fetch and read ANY URL or Google Drive share link. list_folders: all folders. list_folder: contents of one folder (needs folder_id or name).

file_id.description: Drive file ID. Required for action='read' and 'info'. Get from list/search/recent result's 'id' field. Never guess.

name.description: File name to search for. Required for action='read_by_name'.

url.description: URL to fetch. Required for action='read_url'. Works with Google Drive share links (e.g. docs.google.com/...), Google Docs export links, or any public URL that returns text/HTML.

limit.description: Max files to return for list/recent/search. Defaults to 10.

folder_id.description: Folder ID for action='list_folder'. Get from list_folders result.
